description: This file defines a Freemarker template directive class 'CatalogUrlDirective' used within the OFBiz framework to generate URLs for catalog navigation. It processes input parameters and utilizes a servlet method to construct URLs dynamically during template rendering.

classes.name: CatalogUrlDirective
classes.description: A Freemarker Template Directive that generates URLs for catalog items based on provided request parameters; used within the OFBiz framework to facilitate URL creation in templates.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes the directive by extracting parameters from the template environment and request, then writes a generated URL to the output stream.
